summary: Configured node1 with a persistent 512 MiB LUKS2-encrypted ext4 volume mounted at /srv/secure. It unlocks through /etc/crypttab and mounts through /etc/fstab. Automatic recovery and retained data were verified after reboot.
actions_performed: Created a root-owned, mode-0600 encryption key and LUKS2 container.
Created an ext4 filesystem and mounted it at /srv/secure.
Configured systemd-generated cryptsetup and mount units.
Verified automatic activation from a fully closed mapping.
Rebooted node1 and verified its boot identity changed.
Confirmed the encrypted mapping, mount, and test data recovered automatically.

evidence.summary: Shows an active LUKS2 AES-XTS mapping backed by /var/lib/secure-volume.luks, with ext4 mounted from /dev/mapper/secure at /srv/secure.
Shows the crypttab and fstab entries, generated systemd units, and successful automatic reopening of a closed mapping when the mount unit started.

Captures the healthy baseline with boot ID a95da956-aa3e-4fec-a746-fbb828074410, reboot acknowledgement, changed boot ID 60182b38-1c34-4ff6-8fd2-636dee070fd1, and post-restart proof that the cryptsetup and mount units are active and the payload checksum is unchanged.
